## Scope (Chat 03B1 / issue #439)
Isolated, undeployed **D1-compatible SQLite atomic transition foundation** for future authoritative gameplay storage. Four new files only; no runtime, telemetry, economy, UI, NPC, voting or Stage 7.15 changes.

- `gameplay-server/migrations/0001_tactical_state.sql`: distinct `gameplay_battles`, `gameplay_command_receipts`, `gameplay_event_outbox`. An `INSTEAD OF INSERT` trigger on a write-only view validates version/CAS, immutable participant snapshot fields, event IDs and writes state+receipt+outbox in **one SQL statement**. Stale version or event collision aborts the statement. This addresses the 0-row UPDATE issue in D1 `batch()`.
- `gameplay-server/test/test_cas_sql.py`: 22 real-SQLite unit/integration test methods, including two-connection same-version race and rollback.
- `.github/workflows/chat03b1-gameplay-cas.yml`: isolated PR CI for SQLite integration tests.
- `gameplay-server/README.md`: transaction and trust-boundary contract.

**IMPORTANT:** This PR is NOT an approved gameplay backend, NO production DB provisioned/deployed, NO player authentication, NO network API, NO D1 runtime test, NO secure PvP claim. It must remain Draft; actual Cloudflare D1 trigger/concurrency behavior is a later gate. It explicitly does not touch `telemetry-receiver` or its 30-day retention.

Base: `main@57244500e58d1ee6f0b7f2f5e87cd2e63bb83dcb` (PR #438 merged).
Reference: [issue #439](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/issues/439), [Chat 03 Notion](https://app.notion.com/p/3fc815ae752f81968c5bf2b09c262045).

**Earlier SQLite recheck was on HEAD `67bb433731cb3ed8f5f78f9b0e4f2056a6aa5d99`:** [Gameplay SQLite CI #38994902546](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/38994902546) COMPLETED/SUCCESS (16/16), [AI Forensics #38994902896](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/38994902896) COMPLETED/SUCCESS. Both original [independent blockers](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/pull/440#issuecomment-6228212806) repaired, with exact receipt/outbox ID bijection and event.version fencing. [Independent follow-up review](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/pull/440#pullrequestreview-5555562950): `PASS_2_BLOCKER_RECHECK_SQLITE`, not complete Chat03B review or Cloudflare D1 validation.

**Remaining gates:** prove the SQL trigger/CAS/concurrency on real isolated Cloudflare D1 and resolve gameplay identity, authority, retention/backup and deployment policy. Keep Draft/unmerged until those checks and explicit merge authorization; no runtime/Safari/PvP acceptance.

### 2026-10-19: Wrangler local D1 integration, current HEAD

Exact HEAD `957020541a384bda92153c7749dc6c17e5a607b6`. [Gameplay CAS workflow #39251107667](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39251107667) SUCCESS: `sqlite-cas` (18 Python methods) and `wrangler-local-d1` (workerd + isolated D1 binding, migration, CAS, rollback, race). [AI Forensics PR workflow #39251107442](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39251107442) SUCCESS. Wrangler revealed genuine type conversion mismatch: JS integer Number parameters enter D1 as SQL REAL; SQL trigger fixed to accept only integral safe REAL/INTEGER values. [Root cause and test evidence](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/pull/440#issuecomment-6267056873). **Not remote Cloudflare-hosted D1**, not ready for merge/deploy. Requires renewed independent review on current HEAD and separate Cloudflare gameplay DB/auth/retention approval.

## Current-head genesis/outbox coverage (2026-10-21)

Current HEAD `ed6c01d50b49a5afa02437dac096c2f9e0551836`: new `gameplay_create_battle` trigger atomically creates version-0 battle+stable `battle.created` outbox event, with rollback regression tests. Local Wrangler/workerd D1 now exercises **actual merged Chat03A lifecycle** creation and first selection commit, rather than synthetic snapshots alone; verifies opponent public view hides the selection. Exactly **22 SQLite Python tests**. [Exact PR SQL/Workerd CI #39600820110](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39600820110) SUCCESS; [AI Forensics #39600820516](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39600820516) SUCCESS. [Full proof](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/pull/440#issuecomment-6316349744).

Previous hosted D1 SQL API PASS does **not** cover this newer genesis trigger. Hosted retest and independent current-head review remain required. Dependent [Draft PR #441](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/pull/441) is stacked separately, not integrated. Do NOT deploy the unauthenticated test probe Worker or merge without approvals.
